#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Add the staging directory for the **kms** repo. See https://github.com/kubernetes/org/issues/3630 for details.

Please note that we're already in [Test Freeze](https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/blob/master/releases/release_phases.md#test-freeze) for the `release-1.25` branch. This means every merged PR will be automatically fast-forwarded via the periodic [ci-fast-forward](https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-releng-blocking#git-repo-kubernetes-fast-forward) job to the release branch of the upcoming v1.25.0 release.

Fast forwards are scheduled to happen every 6 hours, whereas the most recent run was: Tue Aug 23 19:46:32 UTC 2022.

/priority important-soon
/triage accepted
/cc @ameukam

`pull-publishing-bot-validate` failures are because the staging repo doesn't exist in master branch yet:

issue_context.body: This repo should start with just the KMS proto code under `k8s.io/kms/apis` (make sure the `OWNERS` files correctly require API approval).  We will expand it later to include the reference implementation code (under some library dirs and an examples dir).

AFAIK: yes. I think it can depend on the SIG charter, but typically it's up to the TLs with some lazy consensus from the broader SIG (send it to the mailinglist etc.). The github management folks will be looking for the SIG to approve.
